## What Sandesh does

- Full-Stack Development: Frontend, Backend & APIs, Databases, Dashboards & admin systems, Integrations, Performance, Responsive systems.
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization): Technical SEO, On-page SEO, Site architecture, Structured data, Performance, Internal linking, Content structure, Search intent, Indexing, Analytics, Conversion-focused optimization.
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): Entity clarity, Structured content, FAQ architecture, Schema markup, Question-based content, Answer-focused information architecture, Semantic relevance.
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): AI crawler access, Citable passages, First-party facts, llms.txt, Entity consistency, Server-rendered content.
- Tools: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, MySQL, Oracle SQL, Tailwind CSS, Python, Docker, nginx, Hostinger, DigitalOcean, Google Cloud, Git.
